Definition: from G2827; a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country:--part, region.
BiblicalUsage: Klima is a region, a tract of country. Romans 15:23 says Paul has no more place in these parts, 2 Corinthians 11:10 locates his boasting in the regions of Achaia, and Galatians 1:21 says afterwards he came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the regions are the map of Paul's obedience: he went where there was no more place, and he boasted only where Christ was true.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
